merchants.name: merchant_nbp
intro: Hey!
It's not every day you see a new face around here!
What I'm doing here?
I'm trying to sell these huge boots I've got to some passing giant or troll...
They don't fit me, so I figured why not try to make a quick buck instead of throwing 'em out?
What, you want 'em?
That's funny! They probably won't fit you, but I won't stop you from buying 'em!
I'd say I could get [gold_count] silver for them from any troll. So that's gonna be the price!
sale: Hey, pal. Did you get the [gold_count] silver?
Welcome back, brother.
You're here for the boots I reckon
I'll let 'em go for [gold_count] silver like I said!
I was just thinking of you!
I met this really stingy guy when you were away -
What, the boots?
Well, do you have the [gold_count] silver?
Ah, hello again friend.
Can't stop thinking about those boots, huh?
It'll be [gold_count] silver for 'em.
Hi there bud!
Oh, still all about the boots huh?
Well, if you've got the [gold_count] silver on ya they're all yours!
sell: You have the silver...! Alright, we've got ourselves a deal pal!
Just don't complain to me if they're too big.
noGold: Don't have the silver on ya?
Don't sweat it, I'm sure you'll get it together.
Just listen to me alright?
Still no luck?
You're gonna make it if you listen to my advice some more!
Still not enough huh?
To be honest they're not really worth [gold_count] silver, but that's the market price alright!
Don't look at me like that, I can sell them to some troll instead if you don't want 'em anymore!
Not enough?
No big deal.
I'm waiting for the big fish to swim around, as per usual.
Alright man, not everyone's rich.
No worries.
Still out of luck, huh.
Get a broader perspective and you're gonna get the money flowing in no time!
Not enough on you?
Times are hard indeed... Anyways,
Not enough? No big deal.
I'm telling you, they're not really worth [gold_count] silver.
It's just what I'd be able to sell them for to some dumb troll.
sold: How in the world did you scratch that silver together then?
Come on bud, spill the beans, I'm curious!
Found it all laying around on the floor huh?

merchants.name: merchant
intro: Greetings!
These boots are fit for a legendary hero!
Crafted by a distinguished master, with these you'll get to that babe in no time!
Since I like you I'll cut you a deal...
For only [gold_count] measly gold, they are yours!
What do you say, eh?
sale: Never slip with these expert-jumpers' boots!
Only [gold_count] gold, and you will stand steady forever!
Great for those steep climbs!
Tired of falling?
Then these boots are for you!
Extra special price, [gold_count] gold!
With these boots, you will soar through the sky like a bird!
Winged boots, only [gold_count] gold!
I saw you eyeing these boots!
The babe couldn't possibly resist a man with these works of art on his feet!
Get them while they're hot! [gold_count] gold!
Imagine flying through the sky!
Not possible!
But next best thing is these boots!
For only [gold_count] gold you will feel like you're flying!
Say good-bye to falling ever again!
With these boots you will feel the sensation of flight!
[gold_count] gold and they are yours forever!
Tired of hitting your face on the ground over and over?
Buy these boots and never fall again!
[gold_count] gold! Satisfaction guaranteed!
Have you been to the babe yet? - Of course not! How could you hope to reach her with those old boots on?
But you are in luck! For only [gold_count] these very-special boots can be yours!
Nothing could stop you with these beauties on!
Extra sale!
Performance-enhancing boots!
Exclusive and Limited Time Offer of [gold_count] gold!
Do you see this quality? Luxurious snake skin leather...
I give you extra good price, only for you!
[gold_count] gold!
Buy while you can!
Stock is running low!
[gold_count] gold!
sell: And here you go! Extra-Special Performance-Enhancing Boots!
Put them on and leap away!
noGold: Oh, you don't have [gold_count] gold on you? I'm afraid the price point is at the bare minimum...
Oh, you can't afford the humble price of [gold_count] gold? ...My condolences.
[gold_count] is still too steep a price huh? Well, I'm not running a charity here alright?
Not enough gold eh? As usual...
Oh... I'm sure you will find some gold one day! It's merely [gold_count] gold after all!
If you were broke you could have said so from the start...
You don't have even as little as [gold_count] gold? Oh well...
You still don't have [gold_count] gold? What a shame...
Ah, I understand you can't afford them, times are hard indeed... But I need my gold! And you need these boots!

merchants.name: owl_chars/owl_mold_man
intro: Hey, pal!
Have you seen Ghost Lady?
She is held captive by demons at The Top, but she visits me in spirit!
Yes! She is my wife!
She comes every day, motivating me to save her!
She leaves these fragments for me! I just can't get enough of them!
Help me find more! I will give you my shoes!
I think... [gold_count] of her fragments should be enough to last a while!
sell: Oh? You found [gold_count] fragments of Ghost Lady, my wife!?
Thank you! Now if you will excuse me... I have a date waiting!
Oh, I almost forgot! Here, take my shoes!

merchants.name: owl_chars/owl_shroom_guy
intro: You look like a dude on my wavelength!
Sure, take the hat, keep it bro!
What, you want this cool jacket too?
Well I gotta tell you, it's for true scholars only...
To really be part of this academy you first gotta prove you have an open mind!
Hmm...
Have you seen those nice mushrooms around this place?
They are hidden everywhere in this forest.
Yeah, that's your rite of initiation, man!
Bring me [gold_count] mushrooms and you'll be a true member of the forest scholars.
Before you go I gotta warn you! There is a dark hole over there...
Whatever you do, don't go near it!
Anyways my dude, better get started looking for those mushrooms!
sell: Whoa, dude! You got the mushrooms!
I gotta say I had my doubts. But you pulled through for the higher cause!
You're an official scholar of the forest, bro!
And here is the garment to prove it! Off you go now!

merchants.name: snake
intro: How amusing, he approaches without shaking...
He should know he is fortunate... Weaker men have not been as lucky.
By his stance we see him as our like - a being of absolute will...
To prove that we are not mistaken, he will deliver us the Blood Red Stone.
sell: Yes... The Blood Red Stone delivered at last...
We will grant him a token of our recognition.
noGold: Yes... Deliver the Blood Red Stone, and we will bestow upon him a favour no mortal would dare ask for.
Will he deliver the Blood Red Stone, or is he as weak and limp as they always are?
He has yet to prove his worth...
Should he bring the Blood Red Stone he may yet have a chance of our consideration.
He still shows a foolish attachment to his feeble-minded goal.
If he brought us the Blood Red Stone we would be assured he is wiser.
The Blood Red Stone has not been delivered to us.
We would advise him to consider his judgement - if he wants to retain any hope to receive our favour...

labels.MENUFACTORY_INVENTORY_SILVER_DESC: A small silver coin. There is a portrait of an old man on one side of it.
labels.MENUFACTORY_INVENTORY_GIANTBOOTS_DESC: Quite large boots. If you tried to walk in these you would probably look stupid.
labels.MENUFACTORY_INVENTORY_CROWNNBP_DESC: Cool hat. It has a pleasant scent.
labels.MENUFACTORY_INVENTORY_CROWN_DESC: Solid gold. The quality seems impossible to recreate with human tools.
labels.MENUFACTORY_INVENTORY_RUBY_DESC: A red stone with an alluring sheen, it seems as though it is staring back.
labels.MENUFACTORY_INVENTORY_CAP_DESC: A trendy and fashionable head ornament.
labels.MENUFACTORY_INVENTORY_SNAKERING_DESC: A metal ring. It is quite heavy and cold to the touch.
labels.MENUFACTORY_INVENTORY_GOLDRING_DESC: A golden trinket with a hole in it.
labels.MENUFACTORY_INVENTORY_SHOES_DESC: They have a very cool design, with wings at the heels.
labels.MENUFACTORY_INVENTORY_BUG_NOTE_DESC: I think it's pretty clear who won. Hehehe! Smell ya later!
